top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is a mature, independently reproduced result at the 10^-18 level across RIKEN, JILA, NIST, PTB and SYRTE, with a distinct central idea (magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms) that separates it from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, and a compact two-name allocation that six members already share. P002 ranks next because it contains the same sound part, but it adds a one-name IceCube credit that I cannot defend against the collaboration and that lies outside my field. P003 is physics I value as a condensed-matter theorist, but three names over five credited candidates and its platform character make the allocation less secure. No award is last because a verified, reproducible discovery is available.
